Storage & backup

All data lives on this device, in this browser — there is no server. Storage capacity here tracks free disk space rather than a fixed per-site cap, so it comfortably holds thousands of candidates and lakhs of voter records; photos still take up the most room of anything stored.

Danger zone

Pick any Verity backup file. Verity detects whether it is a voters, administrator or full backup and replaces only that part — a voters backup never touches administrator data, and vice versa.

Backup restored successfully.

If the browser's site data is cleared, private/incognito mode is closed, or a different browser/device is used, none of this data carries over — it never leaves this device. Download a backup regularly if this data matters.
